column3: Close to the Hebrew; “make known to Me” is rendered “you instruct Me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “if you know understanding” is rendered “if you have understanding.”
The Hebrew begins “And he shut in”; NASB supplies “Or who” from the preceding questions.
“I broke My boundary on it” is rendered “I placed boundaries on it.”
“And you will not add” is rendered “but no farther,” and “one will set” as “shall … stop.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from your days” is rendered “ever in your life.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the depth of the deep” is rendered “the recesses of the deep.”
“Have you paid attention to” is rendered “Have you understood,” and “all of it” as “all this.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the storm of thunderclaps” is rendered “the thunderbolt.”
NASB supplies “land” after “waste and desolate,” and renders “the going forth of vegetation” as “the seeds of grass.”
Close to the Hebrew; “are captured” (frozen) is rendered “is imprisoned.”
